evidence.quote: verified the calibration against the June reference plates

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertions of calibration status and verification, but no ratification language or performed declarative that settles the matter as a decision; the position is asserted and defended with evidence, yet remains moveable.
Flat declarative identification of the instrument; no hedging but also no settling or ratification language — a straightforward asserted fact at claim level.
Restates the calibration and its verification as a flat asserted fact; no performed ratification or operational 'we're doing X' that would lift it to decision.
